title: Amorepacific invests in biotech firm Junevity to create ‘next-generation’ skin longevity cosmetics
summary: Laneige-owner Amorepacific has made a strategic investment in biotechnology company Junevity to utilise its RESET Platform – a tool that can discover novel skin-ageing pathways

extraction.key_fact: 아모레퍼시픽이 새로운 피부 노화 경로를 발견하는 플랫폼을 활용하기 위해 바이오테크 기업 주네비티에 전략적 투자를 단행했다.
